summary: Tyler Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a $1 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement, replacing its existing $700 million facility. The new credit agreement matures May 28, 2031, with an accordion feature allowing incremental loans up to the greater of $525 million or 100% of EBITDA. There were no borrowings outstanding at closing. This is a routine refinancing of corporate credit, not a special situation transaction. No merger, tender, spin-off, or similar event is involved.
